tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground: pale silk by day, near-black rose by night. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, article panel, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code, tag hover, quiet wells. `muted` text is not used on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card outlines, dividers, table rules, nav rule.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, inputs and tag outlines — control borders at 3:1+ on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles, strong text on canvas, surface and the silk tints (11:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Prose on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (8:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates, reading time, captions on canvas and surface (5:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: separator dots, idle strokes. Never readable text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rose — the one action colour: primary button fill, links, active nav, eyebrows, drop caps. 5.3:1 light / 8:1 dark on canvas.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (6:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Active TOC row, selected tag, note callout ground; `ink` and `accent` text read on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset; 5:1+ on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gilt hairlines, ornaments (✦), arch outlines, quote marks. Decorative only in the day theme (2.8:1) — never text there.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Silk tint 1 — ribbons, card plates, the cover, the spotlight glow. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: pearl
tokens.usage: Silk tint 2 — the middle of the silk gradient.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Silk tint 3 — the sea. Gradient end, cover, illustration only.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The obscur: footer and spotlight sections in both themes.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Headings and logo on `night`.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Links and small text on `night` (8:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Fenced code ground — dark in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on `code-bg` (5.6:1).

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords — rose.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings — lagoon.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Functions and types — gold.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, constants, booleans — apricot.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Highlighted-line band and header rule inside code blocks.

tokens.name: tip-ink
tokens.usage: Tip callout text on `tip-bg`; always with the word TIP.

tokens.name: tip-bg
tokens.usage: Tip callout ground.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning callout text on `warn-bg`; always with the word WARNING.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning callout ground.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger callout text on `danger-bg`; always with the word CAREFUL. Tip is teal, so tip and danger never rely on red vs green.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger callout ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero only. `ink`, one word italic in `accent`.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A short, honest write-up of what worked.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Permissions should describe what a user can do, not who they are.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons and nav links. Always uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, footer heads, callout labels. Uppercase, `accent` or `muted`.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe like a stage; components stay tight.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Meta gaps, tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside button groups, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default element gap; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Block rhythm in prose; card grid gap; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Space above h2; header-to-body gap.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Article header to body; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Hero and spotlight section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, inline code — crisp, poster-like.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top corners of arch plates (card art, hero frame, images). Bottom corners stay radius-sm.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the avatar disc only.

shadow.note: Light comes from tone, not drop shadows. One soft lift on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Post card hover, primary button hover.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Focused input inner ring, with the `focus` outline.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Home, archive and footer content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Article prose column (~65ch at body).

tokens.name: wide
tokens.usage: Code blocks, figures and tables may break out to this width.
